/blo can rnams kyi dga' ba bskyed phyir 'khor gyi nang du sna tshogs rgyas par ston mdzad cing / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos kyi sgra skad rgya chen 'jig rten kun du 'phro bar mdzad pa po/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs sku chos kyi rgyal srid gnas pa gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad phyir la la dag tu me 'bar bzhin du gang snang zhing / /la lar yang ni rdzogs par byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu zhi ba gang snang la/ /sna tshogs thabs tshul rnams kyis rnam pa du mar 'jug cing srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs sel ba/ /phyogs bcur chub mdzad thub pa rnams kyi sprul sku don chen gang yin de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can don gcig rgyun du mdzad cing bsod nams ye shes chen po dpag med las byung ba'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsum yid dang tshig gi lam las rab tu 'das pa la/ /bdag gis dad pas phyag byas dge ba byang chub sa bon bsags par gyur pa gang yin des/ /sku gsum thob nas 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams byang chub lam la nges par 'dzud par shog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'jug par/ chos sku dang / longs sku dang / de'i rgyu mthun gyi sku zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid mngon sum du mdzad pa'i sku 'og min gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyi spras pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang nyid kyi sku gcig gam ba spu'i khung bu gcig la'ang rang gzhan gyi dus gsum gyi spyod pa dang 'khor 'das kyi snang ba ma lus pa ston pa ste/ 'di la sprul pa'i sku zhes pa'i tha snyad ni mi mdzad par snang ngo / /'di dag la sku gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa yang / /dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis/ /zhes pa'i snga 'grel du/ sku gsum rdzogs par brjod na rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' bar zin kyang bzhed pa la mnga' bsgyur ba nyid phun sum tshogs par bstan pa'i phyir bshad pa/

zhes pas 'grub bo/ /'o na sprul sku'i tha snyad gtan mi bzhed dam snyam na/ de lta bu'i sku gsum brnyes zin nas gdul bya gang na yod pa'i gnas de dang der mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i gang la ci 'dul ston pa nyid sprul skur bzhed de/ slar yang mi g.yo'i sku mnga' khyod kyi srid gsum byon nas sprul rnams kyis/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ bcom ldan 'das ni khams gsum las 'das su zin kyang sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis yab dang yum dang sras la sogs pa dang 'brel par ston cing 'jig rten dang rjes su mthun te/ zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa brten pa ye shes ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par sku gsum dang ye shes bzhi las ma bshad la/ sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga ni rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin par gsungs pas/ 'dir yang ye shes ni bzhi ste/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /dang po la/ rgyu dang ngo bo gnyis las/ rgyu la ngo bo'i rgyu dang gnas gyur gyi rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ thos bsam gyi shes rab ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'dzin pa'i phyir dang zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun gzhi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa las/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes gang yin pa/ /de ni me long ye shes gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ g.yo byed gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i cha nas 'jog pa'o/ /mnyam nyid ye shes la'ang gnyis las/ rgyu la ngo bo'i rgyu ni/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid bsgom pa las byung ba yin te sems mnyam phyir zhes so/ /gnas gyur gyi rgyu ni nyon mongs pa can gyi yid do/ /ngo bo'i khyad par ni 'khor 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i cha nas 'jog pa'o/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la gnyis las/ rgyu la ngo bo'i rgyu ni gzhan la chos bstan pa las byung ba yin te/

yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang / /zhes so/ /gnas gyur gyi rgyu ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa'o/ /ngo bo'i khyad par ni chos can ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i cha nas 'jog pa'o/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la gnyis las/ rgyu la ngo bo'i rgyu ni gzhan gyi bya ba bsgrub pa la brten nas byung ba yin te/ bya ba sgrub pa nyid kyi phyir/ /zhes so/ /gnas gyur gyi rgyu ni sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa'o/ /ngo bo'i khyad par ni sems can gyi khams dang / bag la nyal mkhyen pa'i sgo nas 'jog pa'o/ /de ltar ye shes bzhi po de dag spros pa dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid la rgyu dang yon tan gyi ldog pa gzhan snang gi blos rnam par gzhag pa tsam zhig ni 'gal ba med la/ rang snang la ni mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba med do/ /de bzhin du 'jug par/ ji ltar snod kyi dbye bas mkha' la dbye ba med de ltar/ /dngos byas dbye ba 'ga' yang de nyid la med de yi phyir/ /ro mnyam nyid du yang dag thugs su chud par mdzad gyur nas/ /zhes pa'i ldog pa nas ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / /mkhyen bzang khyod kyis skad cig gis ni shes bya thugs su chud/ /ces pa'i yon tan gyi ldog pa nas ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes su bzhag ste/ de gnyis tha dad du snang ba gzhan snang dang / rang snang la dbye ba med pa'i tshul ni snga ma ltar ro/ /gsum pa mdzad pa phrin las la bzhi ste/ dbye ba dang / rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ba'i tshul dang / des lhun gyis grub par bzhag pa'i tshul dang rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa nas lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa'i bar nyi shu rtsa bdun gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni mdo dag las gsungs pa'i tshul bsdu na/ sna tshogs pa dang / khyab byed pa dang /

lhun gyis grub pa dang / gcig tu phan pa dang / dus las mi 'da' ba dang / bar mi chad pa dang / rgyun mi chad pa dang / 'dres pa las so zhes gsungs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gdul bya gang dang gang gis gdul ba la ji ltar 'tshams pa ltar de dang de'i rnam pa sna tshogs ston yang 'di bya'o snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ba ste/ spyod 'jug las/ yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /ji ltar re ba yongs skong ba/ /de bzhin gdul byar smon lam gyi/ /dbang gis rgyal ba'i skur snang ngo / /dper na nam mkha' lding gi ni/ /mchod sdong bsgrubs nas 'das gyur pa/ /de 'das yun ring lon yang de/ /dug la sogs pa zhi byed ltar/ /byang chub spyod pa'i rjes mthun par/ /rgyal ba'i mchod sdong bsgrubs pa yang / /byang chub sems dpa' mya ngan las/ /'das kyang don rnams thams cad mdzad/ /ces dang / 'jug pa las/ ji ltar rdza mkhan stobs chen ldan pas 'dir/ /yun ring ches 'bad pas bskor 'khor lo ni/ /de'i rtsol da lta skyes pa med bzhin du'ang / /'khor zhing bum pa la sogs rgyur mthong ltar/ /de bzhin da lta skyes rtsol med bzhin du/ /chos kyi bdag can sku nyid la bzhugs de'i/ /'jug pa skye bo'i dge dang smon lam gyi/ /khyad par gyis 'phangs las ches bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' bar phrin las sna tshogs 'byung bas lhun gyis grub pa nyid kyi dpe ni/ rgyud blar/ brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang / /nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /zhes dpe dgu'i sgo nas bstan to/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ rgyud mtha' yas dang sems can zad med dang / /brtse dang 'phrul dang mkhyen dang phun tshogs ldan/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'chi ba'i bdud bcom dang / /ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag

/ces gzugs sku rtag pa'i rgyu bdun dang / chos sku rtag pa'i rgyu gsum bshad do/ /des na bcom ldan 'das ni yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin mas bskrun nas/ snying rje'i ma ma la gtad pas/ 'jig rten mtha' dag sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba ma yin pa dang / ji srid nam mkha' 'jig par mi 'gyur ba de srid kyi bar du phrin las rgyun mi chad pa yin te/ 'jug pa las/ rgyal ba ji srid 'jig rten mtha' dag mchog tu rab zhi bar/ /'gro ba min zhing nam mkha' rnam 'jig 'gyur min de srid du/ /shes rab yum gyis bskyed pa khyod la thugs brtse ma ma yis/ /tshul lugs byed pas rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba gang la mnga'/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni sna tshogs pa dang / rgyun mi chad pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /da ni khyad par can gyi dbu ma de nyid la 'jug pa gdams par bya ste/ de ltar shes bya stong pa nyid la/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgron mes/ slob dpon klu sgrub yab sras kyis gzhi lam 'bras bu khyad par 'phags pa'i dbu ma gsal bar bsdus pa 'di ni/ skye bo rtogs pa dang ldan pa dag gis dbu ma'i lugs dang stong pa nyid legs par rtogs pa'ang don che ba nyid dang / shin tu rnyed par dka' ba nyid dang / bar chad mang ba nyid du shes par byas nas/ bdud kyi las dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i dri ma spangs te/ dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / gus pas mnyan pa dang / thos nas kyang nam yang chud mi za bar tshul bzhin du bsam pas nges par bya ba dang / byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang / gzhan la bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de bas gang dag 'di'i don la rtog dpyod med pa dag gis kyang gzhung 'di nyid la spro bas bri ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod par bya ba dang / don rtogs pa nyid du smon lam gdab par yang bya ste/ bsod nams tshad med pa thob pa dang /

nam zhig rtogs par nges pa dang / de la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang zhig bsten pas zab mo dbu ma'i gnad/ /tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i skal ba bzang thob pa/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i tshogs kyi zhabs pad mor/ /bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi 'o/ /mi sdug chu yis 'dod chags dri ma 'khrud kyang sdang ba'i brag ri bshig mi nus/ /byams pa'i me yis zhe sdang tshang tshing bsreg kyang chags pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa min/ /stong dang rten 'byung gcig par rtogs pa'i ye shes mtshon gyis skye ba'i 'bras bu can/ /las dang nyon mongs yal 'dab rgyas pa'i bdag lta'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcod par byed/ /zab mo'i bcud 'di skyob pa nyi ma yis/ /rnam par phye ba'i gsung rab 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /la lar dngos bstan la lar drang phyir du/ /kun rdzob spros pa'i tshogs kyi ston par mdzad/ /de slad drang srong gsung kun stong nyid la/ /gcig tu 'bab cing gzhol ba'i gtam gyi phul/ /ji bzhin smra ba klu sgrub snying po'o zhes/ /rnam mang mdo sde'i tshogs las rab tu bsngags/ /bsngags 'os de yis don dam la dgongs nas/ /rigs pa'i tshogs las spros pa ma lus bkag /bstod tshogs 'ga' las skyon lnga spang phyir du/ /chos dbyings sgrub pa'i tshul gyis yod par gsungs/ /'di dang rgyal tshab dam pa'i gzhung gnyis su/ /ji ltar mthong tshe spros pa nyer zhi zhing / /ji snyed mthong tshe 'gro kun sangs rgyas kyi/ /snying po can du gzigs par gsungs pa mthun/ /'di las gzhan du smra ba ngan pa dag /chos dbyings bden par yod ces sgrogs pa dang / /la la gzhan sems gnas lugs mthar thug tu/ /smra ba gnyis ka rtag chad g.yang sar lhung / /gnas lugs dpyod tshe yod med phyogs bshig nas/ /tha snyad 'jog tshe yod med yin min sogs/ /'jig rten lhan skyes ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/

/'jog pa lugs 'di'i chos su zla bas bzhed/ /de sogs zab cing gting dpag dka' ba'i don/ /mang du thos pa'i rna bas myong ba dang / /blo gros gsal ba'i mig gis mthong ba bzhin/ /sdeb legs mchu sgros mdzes pa'i ngag gis bshad/ /de lta na yang dus shugs snyigs ma dang / /snyigs dus mi rnams bsod nams dman pa'i mthus/ /blo gros dman pa'i tshig sgros ngan pa rnams/ /yid 'ong mdzes pa'i rgyan du re ba mthong / /skal bzang skye bo rnam mang thos pa yis/ /blo gros lus bzang mdzes pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /don bzang tshig gi phreng bar sdeb legs pa/ /'di 'dra'i rgyan bzang 'chang ba'ang yid la re/ /sngon dus mkhas mang legs bshad nya ba can/ /zab don gsal ba'i bzhin ras mdzes pa dag /skal ldan skye bo gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /ji bzhin ston pa ji 'drar bdag gis bshad/ /'di las rab dkar dge tshogs zla dkar rgyas pa'i 'od dkar lta bu gang thob des/ /bde gshegs gsung rab kun+da'i dpal rab rgyas pa'i tshal rab 'gro bas mthong gyur te/ /dam chos bsil zer 'phro ba'i zla zer gtsug nor 'od zer dang 'dres bsten pa'i mthus/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus kun 'byung zung 'jug rnal 'byor sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo dbu ma'i de kho na nyid spyi'i ngag gis ston pa nges don rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni mgon po klu sgrub kyi gzhung lugs tshogs gsum dang / de'i dgongs 'grel thal rang gi gzhung 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa dang / 'jig rten mi 'byed rngog lo brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i legs bshad 'ga' zhig dang / mtha' bral dbu ma'i srol 'dzin pa tshab brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i legs bshad rnams dang / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis legs par bkral ba'i lta ba'i gzhung bzang rnams la brten nas mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges rta nag rin chen rtse thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu bzang po'o//

༈ //oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bskal pa grangs med tshogs gnyis rab bsgrubs shing / /smon lam rgya tsho'i mthar son snyigs dus kyi/ /skye rgu'i dpal mgon shākya seng ge yi/ /gsang gsum yon tan bsam mi khyab der bsngags/ 1 /rgyal ba de yis sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor/ /chos sgo du mar gsungs kun dngos brgyud kyi/ /mi gnas byang chub chen po la gzhol zhes/ /chu bo rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i dpe yis bstan/ 2 /gnas skabs rigs can rnam gsum bkri ba'i phyir/ /theg gsum lam dang mthar thug theg gcig gzhung / /zab rgyas mkha' dang gzhal med khang bzhin du/ /chen po bdun ldan theg mchog dbu ma la/ 3 /'jug tshul shing rta'i srol 'byed rnam gnyis las/ /zab mo lta ba'i lam ston klu sgrub kyis/ /tshogs gsum seng ge'i nga ros dngos smra'i wa/ /pham mdzad bden gnyis gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul/ 4 /chos can chos nyid zung 'jug la dgongs nas/ /stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med dbu ma che'i/ /srol btod 'phags pa lha sogs slob tshogs kyis/ /grub mtha'i rtser gyur de nyid rgya cher spel/ 5 /gzhung lugs phyi mo'i dbu ma ku mud tshal/ /legs bshad 'dab brgyar grol mdzad zla ba'i zhabs/ /bzhed tshul thal 'gyur bdud rtsi'i bsil 'od 'bum/ /lo chen nyi ma'i gzi byin dang 'dres nas/ 6 /ljongs 'di'i skal bzang dpal du shar ba'i mod/ /mtha' bzhi'i spros pa'i rmongs mun rab bcom zhing / /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i 'bras bzang smin pa dang / /lhan cig nges legs mchog gi 'byor pa brtas/ 7 /rgyud dang sde snod gtsor gyur shes bya'i gnas/ /'khrul bral ji bzhin gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon rnams dang e waṃ pas/ /'phags pa yab sras lugs bzang rgyas par mdzad/ 8 /de tshe blo gsal rgyu skar tshogs 'ga' zhig /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rang 'od cher spros kyang / /thub bstan snying po'i legs bshad ma rnyed cing /

/lta grub rnam dag lam bzang gsal ma gyur/ 9 /phul byung blo gros mig dbang ma thob pas/ /dmus long gzugs la dpyod bzhin dbu ma'i don/ /yod med phyogs bzung gsar byung grub mtha' la/ /phal cher mos pa snyigs ma'i chos nyid do/ 10 /theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'i 'jug sgo du/ /dgongs dang ldem dgongs tshul gyis gsungs pa ste/ /nges don dbu ma'i theg pa dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gshegs pa'i lam chen yin/ 11 /de slad gzhung 'dir thos dang rtogs dka' zhing / /bdud las kyis 'tshe mi dge'i bshes gnyen gyis/ /lta sgom log par spyod pas yid can rnams/ /phung 'gyur gsung rab nyid las gsal bar bshad/ 12 /de phyir rnam dpyod ldan pas grub pa'i mtha'/ /yang dag la 'jug mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs bsten/ /dad gus brtson 'grus rnam gsum shes rab kyis/ /rnam dag lta bar rtogs pa'i thabs la 'bad/ 13 /sdug bsngal phrag brgya'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin tshal/ /dmigs bral lta ba'i zhugs kyis rab bsregs pas/ /thabs shes zung 'jug lam mchog dbu ma ni/ /mthong 'gyur thabs gzhan rgyal bas gsungs pa med/ 14 /brjod bya don gyi dbu ma gzhi lam 'bras/ /mkha' dang shing rta nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /bden gnyis tshogs zung sku dang ye shes rnams/ /kun la khyab cing bden brdzun rang bzhin med/ 15 /'khor 'das go 'byed srid zhir mi lhung brtan/ /mya ngan tshogs bral bde zhing 'bras thob myur/ /'byung ba dkon la phan che blang dor sogs/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' phrin las lhun gyis grub/ 16 /rjod byed dbu ma bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis/ /sher phyin 'bum pa la sogs dang po ste/ /rtsa ba shes rab la sogs phyi ma yin/ /de dag dgongs pa 'grel byed rnams mang yang / 17 /mtha' bral dbu ma'i chos nyid kun gsal ngos/ /nor 'khrul mun pa ring spangs legs bshad kyi/ /snang ba 'bum 'byed bstan pa'i nyi ma ni/ /kun mkhyen go rams chen po zhes su grags/

18 /rgyal ba'i phrin las yul dus gdul bya la/ /dgongs nas gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /log lam 'phyan pa'i 'gro rnams drang ba dang / /nges don lung gi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i phyir/ 19 /bsom̐d nam̐ms ye shes lus stobs cher rgyas shing / /bde gshegs gsung rab sengam̐ ge'im̐ nga ro yis/ /thub bstan gangs rir skyong zhing rgol ngan gyi/ /gnyis 'thung dregs pa'i klad 'gems de nyid kyis/ 20 /yid ches lung dang dam pa'i man ngag dang / /dngos stobs rigs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis bkral ba'i/ /khyad par bzhi ldan ngem̐s gsang dbu ma'i dom̐n/ /ram̐b gsam̐l yid bzhin nor mtshungs gzhung bzang 'dir/ 21 /gzur gnas blo ldan skye bos rtogs pa dang / /lta grub dag dang ma dag 'byed pa'i phyir/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo ru/ /ngo mtshar yi ge'i gzugs kyi cho gas bkod/ 22 /nyi zla'i gzi brjid nor bu'i byin mthu dang / /rigs sngags grub dang sman gyi nus pa ltar/ /bstan bcos mchog 'dir spar du legs bsgrubs pa'i/ /rnam dkar gang mchis yongs su bsngos pa'i mthus/ 23 /bslab gsum nor ldan dge 'dun sde 'phel zhing / /thub bstan dri med phyogs brgyar dar ba dang / /rmad byung 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las kyis/ /lung rtogs bstan pa srid mthar spel gyur cig 24 /chos kyi dbyings gshegs bla ma dam pa'i tshogs/ /sa lam myur bgrod zag med thugs dgos rdzogs/ /pha mas thog drangs dmigs yul 'brel thogs rnams/ /don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas thob gyur cig 25 /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i yid srubs dpung / /dge ba'i snang bral skyes ngan 'byung po'i bya/ /chos min log pa'i mun khrod gnas bcas kun/ /legs byas nyin mo'i snang bar mthong gyur cig 26 /lhar bcas 'gro rnams rang rang las mthun pa'i/ /lam stegs lam dngos 'god sogs phrin las kyis/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i las lam rgyun bcad nas/

/gtan bde thar pa'i dpal la 'god gyur cig 27 /yang dag rgyud sbyangs theg chen rigs can gyis/ /zab mo'i lta bas don dam gnas lugs rtogs/ /rgya chen spyod pas rdzogs smin sbyong mthar phyin/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i sgron me nyid gyur cig 28 /phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog gsum nyi zla'i phung po srid mkhar rtag brtan pas/ /bskal ngan rgud pa'i smag zhi 'gro kun dge bcu'i chos lam rab zhugs shing / /sde bzhi'i 'bras smin phyogs dus kun du rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ /mdzes shing bkra shis dam pa'i snang ba dkar pos 'jig rten khyab gyur cig 29 /ces thub pa'i bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las can kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i gsung rab zab mo lta ba'i rnam gzhag gsal bar ston pa 'di nyid blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam byed pa'i gzhi dang / rang gzhan gyi rgyud la lta ba rnam par dag pa bde blag tu skye ba'i phyir/ lhag bsam dge ba'i blo can spar gnyer ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis mthun rkyen bgyis te rab tshes sa sprel lor/ grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i gdan sa sde dge lhun grub steng gi spar khang chos mdzod bkra shis sgo mang du spar du bsgrubs skabs yon sbyor ba po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab mtha' yas kyis zhu dag dang chabs cig smras pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs sa skya pa'i/ /lta grub 'khrul med seng ge'i nga ro yis/ /phas rgol glang po'i klad 'gems go rams che'i/ /ring lugs phyogs brgyar 'bar ba'i bkra shis shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 274 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ dbu ma spyi ston/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
